import_metadata.lf_hash_policy: replace CRLF with LF only; all other bytes preserved
import_metadata.edge_policy: unweighted; order within edges ignored; duplicate edges removed
import_metadata.singleton_policy: preserved; semantics are determined by weak/strong MIS definition
import_metadata.id_mapping_policy: sort original integer labels ascending; map to zero-based indices
import_metadata.same_instance_as_paper: unverified; matching summary statistics do not prove edge identity
